_balance: Thresholds are base progress. `pay` scales every reward in that realm (applied last, after the day cap) — design.md § Pacing. 练气 halved 2026-09-15 so the cauldron waits about a week, not two.
_about: The ladder: tiers (this world's realms) with their steps and the progress each step asks for; `pay` scales rewards in that tier; `gate` names the chapter a tier waits for. 练气 has nine 层 (our one exception to 凡人, story DESIGN § 道统): `phases` names them three by three — 一至三层 小成, 四至六层 中成, 七至九层 大成. Every realm past 练气 has no 层: its three steps are 小成, 中成, 大成 themselves (Hanli, 2026-10-09; 小成/中成/大成 is the Daoist word, 《钟吕传道集》, replacing 初期/中期/后期). `full` is the word for a step filled — 练气二层圆满, 筑基中成圆满, 筑基大成圆满 — nothing more goes in until the next step; only the realm's last step filled, its 圆满 (筑基圆满, 练气圆满), is tried for a breakthrough. 巅峰 is the spoken word for the same point (外门's 「九层巅峰」); 圆满 is the formal one, and only it stands in a table. Past 练气 each realm had three steps until 2026-10-03, nine 层 from then to 2026-10-09, and three steps again since, each the sum of its three 层 (state.mjs v6 threeToNine, v7 nineToThree; the thresholds are the pre-10-03 ones, so the realm's whole never changed).
_full: `full`: appended to a step's name when its progress is full (state.mjs fullName; zh 筑基中成圆满, en 'Foundation Establishment · Middle Attainment, Consummation'). The realm's last step filled reads short, realm + word (peakName: 筑基圆满, 练气圆满) — a breakthrough's `from`. Was 大圆满 until 2026-10-09: a Tibetan Buddhist term; 圆满 alone is the Daoist one.
_layers_were: `layers_were`: each realm's nine 层 thresholds as they stood 2026-10-03 → 2026-10-09, kept only so a save made then is carried into the three steps exactly (state.mjs nineToThree): 层 1–3 → 小成, 4–6 → 中成, 7–9 → 大成, the 修为 of the 层 passed in that step added to what it held.
_caps: The cap per 回 (Hanli, 2026-10-05: 「游戏里修炼有个上限吧? 和故事对齐」; rules/cap.mjs): `hui` names, for each 古 回, the highest step (a 层 of 练气, a 成 above it) the player's own work reaches there (`tier`, `layer` 1-based) and, when the 回's scenes carry him further, how far its story goes (`story`; else the same). Filled to the cap, 修为 stops and the rest is held, as at a peak (`say` under the full bar); a scene's rise or breakthrough past `story` is refused (`refuse`). A 回 with none takes the one before it in the book (a 今 interlude, its 古); after 卷一 the save waits in 古九's chapter, so it stays 筑基小成 until 卷二 is written and given its caps; a chapter with no 回 (the old spine) has none — its realm gate rules it. A save already past its cap is never pulled down: it fills its own step and waits for the story. From the book (story/jiuding-lu/OUTLINE.md 境界线, DESIGN § 六·八 定例): 古三 入门 (the game's first 层); 古四 一层, 十月廿五 二层 (lifted at 古四's close, wm-diyilu); 古五 二层 → 四层 by 息壤 (wm-xirang); 古六 四层 (大比 on 四层); 古七 (h11) 四层 until the years carry him to 七层 (09-year `futian`); 古八 (h09) 七层, the years after to 九层圆满 (09-dabi) and the cliff to 筑基 (09-cliff); 古九 (h10) 筑基小成 — the first step of 筑基 (古七 split in two, Hanli 2026-10-07).

say.zh: 坐到圆满了。火候未到，再坐，气也只往外溢。
say.en: Filled to Consummation. The fire is not ready yet; sit on, and the breath only spills over.

refuse.zh: 鼎气不肯近身。火候未到——时候到了，它自己会来。
refuse.en: The cauldron's breath will not come near. The fire is not ready — when its time comes, it will come to you.

_treasure: The nine 重 of a 本命法宝, grown by 温养 and by what a fight leaves — design.md § 斗法.
_breakthrough: 渡劫 is one throw that can fail (Hanli, 2026-09-28: 红检, you pick). The chance starts at `base` for the realm it opens and each factor adds to it, then it is held between `floor` and `cap`. `pill`: the realm's breakthrough pill carried in the bag, worth more the more 转 it has (eaten only by a throw that lands — a failed one keeps it, as the card promises: 境界与所藏不失). `body`: 伤势 is 体力 since 2026-09-24 — at least `share` of the pool is `whole`, under it `hurt`. `seclusion`: out of a 闭关 of at least its min_hours within `hours`. `her`: 银月 at the player's side, plus `per_gift` for each gift the cauldrons gave her. `element`: the realm's 五行; a root of it is `match`, a root that feeds it (相生) is `feeds`. A failure wounds (`fail.wound`, a share of the 体力 pool), takes `fail.progress` of the peak step's 修为 and shuts the cauldron for `fail.cooldown_hours` real hours; the realm, the save and every thing held — the pill too — are never lost; under the peak after a failure, 闭关 brings the 修为 back (the refusal says so). Under `low` a success is marked 逆天.

pill._items: A list is reached for in order: the furnace's 九转 first, the sect's 一转 after (古八 — the 筑基 half of the old 古七, split 2026-10-07: he eats the 九转; the 官丹 he won at the year-five 大比 stays sealed in the 储物袋, unused). A pill's bonus is its own `bonus_of`, else by its 转 (`by_zhuan`, items.json `zhuan`: the 官丹 is 一转下品, +25; the furnace's 九转 +80, near-certain), else `bonus`. 鼎苔 (古五) is the last reached for: eaten raw it steadies the throw a little (bonus_of 10).

breakthrough._odds: 筑基 follows the book (story DESIGN § 定例 · 沉鼎观的数; 2026-10-03): without a pill about one in ten gets through (base 10), the sect's one 一转 lifts it to a few in ten, a 九转 makes it near-certain. `floor` 5: a throw is never hopeless.
